answer: The wharf is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ripple. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the tide of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution. Written in a academic prose with citations to prior work register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
